hash_semantics.primary_manuscript_bytes: Exact pinned bytes of the named primary .tex file. A digest of this source is not an archive digest.
hash_semantics.archive_bytes: Exact bytes of the ZIP present at the analysis pin.
hash_semantics.directory_manifest_sha256: SHA256 of UTF-8 concatenation of lines <fileSHA256> + two spaces + <relative path> + newline, sorted by relative path, over tracked files in that packet directory. Byte content is verified against the index Git blob, with Git object bytes used if a local file differs.
hash_semantics.git_blob: SHA-1 Git object ID; distinct from SHA256.

scope_warning: Listing and hashing do not certify mathematical correctness. The 29 indexed records are index reviews; the 5 new records received deeper source audits. Dependencies and formalization status are separately documented.
